description: This file implements POSIX mutex (pthread_mutex_t) functionalities for Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, locking, unlocking, trylock, timedlock, and destruction, with internal management of mutex pool and attributes.

methods.name: pthread_mutex_init
methods.description: Initializes a pthread_mutex_t with optional attributes, sets up internal mutex pool and attributes.

methods.name: pthread_mutex_lock
methods.description: Locks a pthread_mutex_t, blocking until available.

methods.name: pthread_mutex_trylock
methods.description: Attempts to lock a pthread_mutex_t without blocking.

methods.name: pthread_mutex_timedlock
methods.description: Locks a pthread_mutex_t with a timeout specified by timespec.

methods.name: pthread_mutex_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a pthread_mutex_t, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: pthread_mutexattr_getprotocol
methods.description: Retrieves the protocol attribute of mutex attributes.

methods.name: pthread_mutexattr_gettype
methods.description: Retrieves the type attribute of mutex attributes.

methods.name: pthread_mutexattr_settype
methods.description: Sets the type attribute for mutex attributes.
